source.snippet: I am building a GitHub Actions workflow that creates a trial org (Partner Developer / Sales Enterprise) on demand from an Environment Hub with the SignupRequest object and then installs packages into it. To get headless access to the new org I use Proxy Signup: I pass ConnectedAppConsumerKey and ConnectedAppCallbackUrl on the request and plan to exchange the returned AuthCode for a refresh token. [Error C-1016 encountered]

problem_statement: Salesforce ISV partners and developers building automated org-provisioning CI/CD pipelines hit opaque, undocumented errors (e.g. C-1016) in the SignupRequest/Trialforce API, causing significant debugging time with no actionable Salesforce documentation.
target_segment: Salesforce ISV partners, AppExchange developers, and Salesforce consulting shops automating org provisioning and QA environments.
notes: Clear business/developer context — building a production CI/CD pipeline for a Salesforce partner org. These teams pay for dev tools and automation. Potential: a diagnostic/wrapper tool for Salesforce org provisioning APIs, or a documented cookbook/service. Weak signal (1 post) but the pain class (Salesforce API opacity for ISVs) is well-documented historically. Worth monitoring.
